_note: config-decomposer's checked-in routing corpus. This is a LEXICAL-OVERLAP legibility aid, NOT a verdict — routing-eval.py measures token overlap between a phrase and the description only. Positives span the invocation families (imperative 'review/grade this config', diagnostic 'is this terraform/k8s/Dockerfile right', symptom 'plaintext secrets / wide-open permissions / surprise destroy', object-first 'this manifest', plus 2-3 indirect paraphrases). The indirect/paraphrase positives are deliberately low-overlap and MAY score recall 0 here — that is a proxy limit, not a description defect. Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from CONFUSABLE in-repo siblings: config collides with code-decomposer (it is NOT application code), type-decomposer (a schema is not a config artifact), and query-decomposer (SQL/DDL), plus near-misses for live-behavior, architecture, and cleanup that the skill explicitly hands off. Each negative belongs to a NAMED sibling or fenced peer. Re-derive when the neighbourhood changes.
